mapper.select: SELECT section_id, display_label, weight, form_mappings, points_template FROM plan_eval_section WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY section_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_eval_section_result( report_id, section_id, score_points, comment, suggestions_json, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{sectionId}, #{scorePoints}, #{comment}, #{suggestions}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score_points = VALUES(score_points), comment = VALUES(comment), suggestions_json = VALUES(suggestions_json), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id, r.member_id, r.document_id, r.session_id, r.total_score, r.strengths_json, r.risks_json, d.original_filename AS file_name, d.file_path, d.uploaded_at FROM plan_eval_report r JOIN document_uploads d ON d.id = r.document_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sr.section_id, s.display_label AS label, s.weight AS weight, sr.score_points AS score, sr.comment, s.points_template AS points, s.form_mappings AS mappings, sr.suggestions_json AS suggestions FROM plan_eval_section_result sr JOIN plan_eval_section s ON s.section_id = sr.section_id WHERE sr.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY s.section_id
